'''Yogendra Pathak Viyogi''' ('''Y. P. Viyogi''') is an [[Indian people|Indian]] [[physicist]] at [[Indian National Science Academy]]. He is specialized in the field of experimental [[nuclear physics]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=INSA :: Indian Fellow Detail |url=https://www.insaindia.res.in/detail.php?id=P09-1501 |access-date=2022-08-09 |website=www.insaindia.res.in}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |url=https://store.pothi.com/book/ebook-dr-yogendra-pathak-viyogi-fna-fnasc-vigyank-batkahi/ |title=Vigyank Batkahi {{!}} Pothi.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Home |url=http://people.iiti.ac.in/~raghunath/ALICE-India_School_2020/index.html |access-date=2022-08-09 |website=people.iiti.ac.in}}</ref>

{{Blockquote|text="It is certainly a matter of great pride for all of us to be a part of the discovery of anti-alpha, the heaviest anti-matter to have been seen in terrestrial experiments."|author=Subhra Priyadarshini|title=Indian scientists in antimatter discovery|source=[[Nature India]]|character=Y P Viyogi}}

== Early life ==
He was born in the [[Madhubani district]] of the [[Mithila (region)|Mithila region]] in the state of [[Bihar]] in India, in the year 1948.<ref>{{Cite web |title=INSA :: Fellow Detail |url=http://insajournal.in/intranetinsa/fellow_detail.php?id=P09-1501 |access-date=2022-08-09 |website=insajournal.in}}</ref> He completed his primary education at his own village.

He received his post graduate degree in [[physics]] from [[Bihar University]] in [[Muzaffarpur]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=INSA :: Indian Fellow Detail |url=https://insaindia.res.in/old_website/detail.php?id=P09-1501 |access-date=2024-08-05 |website=insaindia.res.in}}</ref>
[[File:The Banyan Tree.jpeg|thumb|View of the campus of the Bihar University in Muzaffarpur.]]

== Scientific career ==
[[File:BARC traning school.jpg|thumb|BARC traning school.]]
He joined the 15th batch of Training School Programme of [[Bhabha Atomic Research Centre]], [[Mumbai]] in 1971. He was trained in experimental nuclear physics at [[Bhabha Atomic Research Centre|BARC]] and at [[Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory|Lawrence Berkeley laboratory]], USA. He moved to Kolkata to work at the [[Variable Energy Cyclotron Centre]], a unit of the [[Department of Atomic Energy]] and obtained his PhD in 1984 from the [[University of Calcutta]]. He was also a postdoctoral fellow at GANIL Laboratory in [[France]] from 1984 to 1986. He was Director of [[Institute of Physics, Bhubaneswar|Institute of Physics]], [[Bhubaneswar]] during June 2006 – June 2009. He retired from service in October 2012 as Outstanding Scientist at VECC [[Kolkata]].<ref name=":0" />
[[File:IOP Bhubaneswar library.JPG|thumb|Library at the Institute of Physics, Bhubaneswar.]]

== Scientific works ==
[[File:Aerial View of Brookhaven National Laboratory.jpg|thumb|Aerial View of the Brookhaven National Laboratory.]]
Y P Viyogi has studied  projectile fragmentation reactions involving intermediate energy of heavy nuclei at [[Berkeley, California|Berkeley]]. He has been also involved in the study of [[Quark–gluon plasma|quark gluon plasma]] using indigenous [[Photon Multiplicity Detector (PMD)|photon multiplicity detector (PMD)]] at [[CERN]] in [[Geneva]] and [[Brookhaven National Laboratory]] in [[United States|USA]]. He led Indian group of [[physicist]]s at the [[ALICE experiment]] in CERN.<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Viyogi |first=Y. P. |last2=Aggarwal |first2=M. M. |last3=Badyal |first3=S. In 2011, he was the leader of Indian physicists in [[STAR experiment]] at [[Relativistic Heavy Ion Collider]] (RHIC) in [[Brookhaven National Laboratory]], USA. There he was involved in the observation and detection of the [[antimatter]] [[helium-4]] [[Atomic nucleus|nucleus]] or anti-alpha. He is one of the physicists who witnessed the discovery of the heaviest anti-matter known as ''anti-alpha'' particle.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Priyadarshini |first=Subhra |date=2011-04-26 |title=Indian scientists in antimatter discovery |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/nindia.2011.58 |journal=Nature India |language=en |doi=10.1038/nindia.2011.58|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Agakishiev |first=H. |last2=Aggarwal |first2=M. == Literary works ==
Apart from being a physicist, he is also involved in the field of [[Maithili literature]] and [[Mithila culture|culture]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-12-04 |title=कथ्य और शिल्प के बल पर अपनी अलग पहचान बनाती है मैथिली कविता |url=https://www.bhaskar.com/bihar/madhubani/news/maithili-poetry-makes-its-mark-on-the-strength-of-story-and-crafts-040611-3337165.html |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=Dainik Bhaskar |language=hi}}</ref> On 27 June 2014, he was honoured as a ''Mithila Vibhuti'' and was awarded the ''Mithila Vibhuti Vidyapati Award'' for his contribution to the Maithili literature and culture, by the ''Gram Vikas Parishad'' at [[Ranti]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=सांस्कृतिक परंपरा की रक्षा आवश्यक - null |url=https://www.jagran.com/bihar/madhubani-11431494.html?app=true&utm_source=referral&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=deeplink |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=Jagran |language=hi}}</ref> He is an prominent figure in the literary activities in the region. He is many times  invited as an important guest in the ceremonies related to the Maithili literature and culture in the region.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2017-06-22 |title=अमलेंदु को साहित्य अकादमी का बाल पुरस्कार |url=https://www.prabhatkhabar.com/state/bihar/darbhanga/1009922 |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=Prabhat Khabar |language=hi}}</ref>

In the year 2022, he was invited as the chief guest for a scholarly festival called 'Gyanotsav-2022' at the premises of the [[Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University]]. It was inaugurated by him at the Senate of the Sanskrit university. The scholarly festival was organised to bring together research scholars on one platform in the region.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-11-07 |title=कामेश्वर सिंह दरभंगा संस्कृत विवि में ज्ञानोत्सव-2022 का शुभारंभ हुआ: शोध करने वाले विद्वानों को एक मंच पर लाने का प्रयास किया गया - Darbhanga News |url=https://www.bhaskar.com/local/bihar/darbhanga/news/efforts-were-made-to-bring-research-scholars-on-one-platform-130528694.html |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=Dainik Bhaskar |language=hi}}</ref>
